usedFor: Sellsy holds companies, opportunities and invoices, and “Invoice Created” there can start “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats.

bestTemplate.name: “Updated Opportunity Status” in Sellsy, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A status change on an opportunity can send a template message, so the contact hears about it.

watchOut: “Send Template Message” reaches someone outside your business, so it waits for your approval before it goes.
